Source/backend must be explicitly selected. No automatic fallback or merge. Stop all external legacy writers before first import.

No MySQL support; SQLite must be a persistent single main database.

Temporary grants remain in memory and expire on parent generation change; durable delegation and child-change policy may be refined separately.
